messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or live data feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. If you need the current time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone, or a computer clock set to the Eastern Time Zone.
message.reasoning: We need to answer current time in NYC. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate using UTC offset. But we need to be careful: It's 2026-11-10. In November, New York is on Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5). So current time would be UTC minus 5 hours. But we don't know current UTC. We could say "I don't have real-time data." But maybe we can approximate: If it's 2026-11-10, we can get current UTC from system? We don't have that. We can respond that we don't have real-time capability. So best to say we can't provide real-time.
